verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents Cortex Code as an AI-driven coding agent integrated into Snowflake for data engineering workflows. Its marketing positions CoWork ("ask anything") and CoCo ("build anything") as built-in agentic AI, and Cortex Analyst lets users ask questions in natural language without writing SQL. Together these show a built-in assistant users can hand tasks to, but the documentation behind each is brief. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what tasks the agent can autonomously perform and where it is surfaced in the UI, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation.
